outcome: Obesity risk from birth to adolescence
cohort: Live births in Mato Grosso, Brazil, in 1999 and 2000
finding: Cesarean birth was positively associated with obesity from birth to adolescence, even after adjusting for confounding factors, but the risk did not increase over time.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth, a mode of delivery, was the primary exposure investigated in this study.
followup_time: Between 0 and 5 years at first assessment, and approximately 10 years at second assessment
